title: API returns 500 on bulk export for workspaces over 10k rows
description: Bulk export endpoint times out and returns a 500 error once a workspace has more than roughly 10,000 rows. Affects the /v2/export endpoint specifically.

title: Add pagination to the admin users table
description: The admin users table loads all users in one request. Needs cursor-based pagination to stay responsive on large accounts.

title: Fix broken foreign key constraint on migration 0042
description: Migration 0042 fails on a fresh database because the foreign key references a table created in a later migration.

title: Redesign the empty state for the reports page
description: New accounts see a blank reports page with no guidance. Needs an illustrated empty state with a clear call to action.

title: Customer can't reset password after email change
description: A customer changed their account email and can no longer trigger a password reset email to either the old or new address.

title: Define pricing for the new team analytics add-on
description: Need to settle on pricing tiers and packaging for the analytics add-on ahead of the beta launch, coordinating with engineering on what's technically feasible to meter.

title: Update icon set to match new brand guidelines
description: Replace the current icon library with the new brand-approved icon set across the web app.

title: Investigate slow dashboard load time reported by three enterprise customers
description: Three enterprise accounts report dashboard load times over 8 seconds. Needs profiling to find the bottleneck.
